title: 6 Members of South Africa’s Biggest Party Are Killed in Shootings
summary_full: The two shootings took place only a few weeks before pivotal, nationwide local elections, and as the party, the A.N.C., is embroiled in a dispute over the eligibility of more than 100 candidates.
